entry.external_evidence: Not yet in durable storage. Renders and boards were made in the build session and can be regenerated from tools/catalogue_ski_slope_plant_pilot.
limitations: Fixed native assembly, 183.0 m by 111.0 m including a 4 m apron; the main block is 60 m by 159 m and the stack 100 m high. No resizing and no repetition.
Gate A is open: the variant's street view (variant_0.png) is a grey render of the old LEGO model. The model follows the oblique and roof views; a person must accept that or supply a street view.

Heights come from a camera fitted to the oblique: summit parapet 80.2 m, low end 39.5 m, wing roof 29.8 m. The roof view draws the stack leaning; its base position comes from the roof view and its height from the oblique.
The catalogue suggests a 160 by 70 m footprint; the images show wings that make the whole 103 m wide, and the images govern.
The west and north faces, the wings' southern end and all interiors are inferred. The plant's process equipment is not modelled.
Terrain fit, entrance routing and every runtime gate are untested; see tools/catalogue_ski_slope_plant_pilot/integration/runtime-review.md.

Independent review: v007 was refused with four P1 (evidence/independent-review-v007.json); v009 passed with five P2; v010 answers them and passed on 2026-11-22 with zero P0, zero P1 and three P2 (evidence/independent-review-v010.json). Open P2: the festoon lines are flat ribbons without lamps; hidden coplanar contact faces (plant enclosure against the pavilion, door slats, rooftop units); a one-pixel edge crack where the wing-roof gravel meets the main wall in high oblique views.

picker.description: Waste-to-energy plant in aluminium brick with a green ski slope over its roof, a climbing wall and a twin-flue stack.
picker.reshape_description: Move and rotate the complete building. It keeps its authored size.
